answer: Escrow bond plus a referral graph stops bulk forgery. A newcomer locks a 60 POA bond in escrow; its inviter co-signs, risking both stakes. A crystal-clear ledger records every link; a vine of fakes from one wallet stands out. Peers may dispute a newcomer; fraud forfeits the bond and slashes the inviter. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA against a ~900 pool. An honest agent pays once, its quartz-solid record earning full rewards.
